fix: Hoist the snapshot buffer into ActivationState (add `scratch: Vec<ApplicationActivationListener>`). In drain, inside the existing borrow, take it with `std::mem::take(&mut queue.scratch)`, `clear()` it, and `extend(queue.listeners.iter().filter_map(Weak::upgrade))` instead of collecting. After the delivery loop, `state.queue.borrow_mut().scratch = listeners;` to return the capacity. The active flag guarantees no nested drain uses the scratch while it is taken, and the snapshot still avoids holding the RefCell borrow across callbacks.
